v: Crowchild Trail is named after a real chief. Who was he?
David Crowchild, chief of the Tsuut'ina Nation from nineteen forty-six to nineteen fifty-three.
When city officials asked to name the road after him, he gave his blessing.
And he said: may this be a symbol of cutting all barriers between all peoples, for all times to come.
